queries_run: Eaton ETN market share gaining OR losing electrical equipment 2026
Eaton competitor data center power design win 2026 Vertiv Schneider Electric
Eaton Boyd thermal acquisition 2026 data center power

findings.claim: Eaton Q1 2026 organic sales growth accelerated to 10% (vs earlier guidance of 5-7%), with data center orders up 240% YoY leading to record-high backlogs; Electrical Americas segment orders grew 42% organically with backlog expansion of 44% and an overall Electrical businesses book-to-bill ratio of 1.2. Full-year 2026 organic growth guidance raised to 11-13%.
findings.source: Eaton Corp plc Form 8-K Q1 2026 earnings exhibit 99, SEC EDGAR (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1551182/000155118226000010/etn03312026exhibit99.htm)

findings.claim: Eaton completed its $9.5B acquisition of Boyd Thermal (liquid-cooling solutions provider) in March 2026, combining Eaton's power management with Boyd's liquid cooling to create what the company calls an industry-leading 'grid-to-chip' solution for AI data centers.
findings.source: Eaton press release / Businesswire, "Eaton completes acquisition of leading liquid-cooling solutions provider Boyd Thermal" (https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260312582488/en/Eaton-completes-acquisition-of-leading-liquid-cooling-solutions-provider-Boyd-Thermal-creating-an-industry-leading-grid-to-chip-solution-for-data-centers)

findings.claim: At NVIDIA GTC 2026 (March 16, 2026), NVIDIA unveiled its DSX (Data Center System eXtended) reference architecture for AI factories; Schneider Electric, Vertiv, and Eaton were all named as contributors of power/cooling infrastructure pieces to this unified reference design, indicating no single vendor has an exclusive lock on the NVIDIA ecosystem's power layer.
findings.source: Yutori scouts summary of GTC 2026 announcements (https://scouts.yutori.com/inbox/d96a11e6-d301-452b-89dd-a3bdb5142ab1)

findings.claim: Industry commentary (Introl blog) describes Vertiv as differentiated from Eaton by being 'the only large company covering both power (UPS/PDU) and cooling simultaneously' prior to Eaton's Boyd Thermal deal closing, while Schneider Electric is described as leading through customer design lock-in.
findings.source: Introl Blog, "Vertiv vs Schneider vs Eaton" (https://introl.com/blog/vertiv-schneider-eaton-cooling-solutions-comparison-ai-data-centers)

customer_second_source.note: 查無任何具體、可歸因於 ETN 的 second-source 或 in-house 化證據。查到的相關材料皆不成立為 finding：(1) 通用說法指 Eaton 前十大客戶未個別揭露、無法辨識最大客戶身份；(2) 一篇談美國電力供應鏈重組的文章提到『大型 OEM 標準開關設備交期 50-80 週，國內具自製能力廠商交期更短』，但以 WebFetch 覆核全文後確認該文並未點名 Eaton（僅點名 Schneider Electric 擴產），故未採用；(3) 查到 hyperscaler（Google/Microsoft/Amazon）大量簽署天然氣輪機/核能 PPA 屬於『自建發電端』而非『自製或替換 Eaton 的配電/開關設備』，層級不同，不構成本軸 second-source/in-house 證據，未列入。
